response.overview: The winds of restless youth grow stronger after you close your eyes and open them again. Faced with the assignment of “finding an interest,” Eugene is startled when he witnesses a “person” bursting a balloon called a dream right in front of him. Soon, another wind-filled balloon appears before Eugene, and he begins to chase it as if enchanted.  After running for what feels like a long time, Eugene is briefly stopped by a road and catches his breath—but he doesn’t give up. In the end, he finally manages to grasp the balloon in his hands.  With this, Eugene’s assignment is complete.
response.title: Wish
